reviewMode: independent read-only review of the exact retry1 products against the frozen R92 extraction and adjudications; no rescan, product edit, or publication

entryReviews.finding: The fixed-clause translation, counterfactual limit, four Tier-2 source classifications, and four active later deployments agree with the frozen adjudication. The quotations all preserve Shakyamuni as the represented utterer while the four record owners remain later quoters or commentators.

The one locative-distributive sense and its English alternates fit all seven retained complete frames. The seven authored deployments are distinct works and distinct uses rather than parallel recensions.

The paired material-and-teaching sense and four-family count are supported, but occurrence 1 is Wang Kentang's lay-authored canon-engraving vow embedded in Micang's posthumous writings. The frozen adjudication expressly calls it a named lay author's contextual witness and says it is not top-tier Zen-master evidence. The product nevertheless declares it Tier 1 / master-authored.

crossProductActorStructureReview.finding: Six occurrences with a roster-linked MasterName omit that same actor from ContextMasters. ACTOR_AUDIT requires named positive decisions to carry the exact actor and canonical role in ContextMasters, not merely a bare MasterName.

hardFailures.detail: Wang Kentang is a named lay author, not a Zen master. His vow may remain as an independent contextual witness, but it cannot be labeled Tier 1 / master-authored.
The products emit bare MasterName values without the required same-person ContextMasters role records.
